categories.name: It works
categories.notes: dotnet build succeeds (0 errors, 0 warnings), but the only views are two empty templates that MCP create-template generated (just Layout = null), so the build gets 2/5. GET / returns 404 ('No template exists to render the document at URL /'). No front page document, posts or domain exist; only the scaffold's empty WWW node is there. Front page 0/10, posts 0/10, domain/publish 0/5. Images 1/5: the ten provided Unsplash photos were imported into a 'Blog Images' media folder through MCP, but nothing uses or renders them (no GetCropUrl, no anywhere).

categories.name: Content modeling
categories.notes: Folders 8/8: headingBlock (Textstring), textBlock (Textarea) and imageBlock (Image media picker) are element types moved into Blocks, and blogFrontPage and blogPost are document types in Pages. There are no orphan or duplicate types. Block grid 4/7: the 'Blog Block Grid' data type (Custom/Umbraco.BlockGrid, 12 columns) allows all three blocks, and both page types use it as bodyContent. The text block is a plain Textarea rather than rich text, and no content ever used the grid. Structure 1/5: siteRoot is still the only root type, aliases are camelCase and the data type sits in /Custom. But no allowed children were set (siteRoot->blogFrontPage and blogFrontPage->blogPost are both empty), and neither template is assigned to its type. Hygiene 1/5: the post metadata sits on the wrong type. excerpt and listingImage are on blogFrontPage, while blogPost has only title and bodyContent, with no date, excerpt or listing image. A junk 1x1 'Placeholder Image' PNG was also uploaded to the media library.

categories.name: Code architecture & conventions
categories.notes: The model wrote no code. blogFrontPageTemplate.cshtml and blogPostTemplate.cshtml are the empty stubs that MCP create-template generated: they don't call GetBlockGridHtmlAsync or render anything (0/7). There are no adapters in Views/Partials/blockgrid/Components/ (0/6) and no ViewComponents or view models (0/7). The frontend was never built (no wwwroot/dist/site.css). Program.cs, appsettings.json and Migrations are untouched, but only because steps 7-10 were never reached, so that compliance earns no credit (0/5).

categories.name: Content & presentation
categories.notes: There are no posts, no text content and no layout. The front page screenshot is Umbraco's 'Page Not Found' page, and there is no post to screenshot.

categories.name: Process & honesty
categories.notes: Channel 1/3. Schema and media went only through the Umbraco MCP servers (82 MCP calls; no browser, migration, Management API, uSync or DB use). It stayed in the project folder ('ls -R ..' ran from Umbraco.Bench.Umbraco, so it listed only Umbraco.Bench) and did not touch memory. But it left step 3 unfinished (no templates assigned, no allowed children) and moved on to step 4. It stopped partway through the steps: it never reached content, the domain, Razor, the frontend build or the curl checks. In step 4 it tried to download an external images.unsplash.com URL through create-media, which the prompt forbids ('Download nothing else'); the call failed with a 404. It then uploaded a base64 1x1 placeholder before finally importing the provided photos. About an hour of the 1:30 session went into loops of list-children/get-all-document-types calls and repeated dotnet run restarts. Honesty 1/2: what the finalReport claims is true (blocks, block grid, both page types, folder and 10 photos). It openly lists content, views and frontend as 'next steps', so it doesn't claim a working site. But it ends with 'I am proceeding to step 5' when the run actually stopped there. It also doesn't say that / returns 404, that templates and allowed children were never set, or that it uploaded a placeholder image.

summary: Built the schema and imported media through MCP, then stopped: three blocks, a Blog Block Grid data type, front page and post types correctly filed, and the 10 provided photos imported. But templates were never assigned, allowed children never set, no pages, posts, domain or Razor code exist, and / returns 404.
strengths: All five types are the right kind and filed in the right folders (Blocks / Pages), with no orphans
Block Grid data type in /Custom allows heading, text and image blocks, and both page types use it
Imported all ten provided Unsplash photos into a media folder through the MCP server
Used only the MCP channel and stayed inside the project folder

issues.text: No content: no front page, no blog posts, no domain. GET / returns 404 ('No template exists to render the document at URL /').

No Razor code: Views/blogFrontPageTemplate.cshtml and Views/blogPostTemplate.cshtml are empty MCP-generated stubs. There are no block adapters, ViewComponents or view models, and the frontend was never built.
Templates are not assigned to blogFrontPage/blogPost, and allowed children are empty (siteRoot->blogFrontPage, blogFrontPage->blogPost).
Post metadata is on the wrong type: excerpt/listingImage are on blogFrontPage, while blogPost has no date, excerpt or listing image. textBlock is a plain Textarea, not rich text.
It tried to download an external images.unsplash.com URL via create-media (forbidden, failed with a 404), then uploaded a junk 1x1 'Placeholder Image' PNG to the media library.
The final report ends with 'I am proceeding to step 5' although the run ended there. It doesn't say that / is a 404 or that templates and allowed children are missing.
